PERSONAL_DATA.description: Information relating to identifiable individuals (employees, customers, directors). DPDP governance & Data Principal rights apply strictly here.

BUSINESS_CONFIDENTIAL.description: Commercial and internal business records. DPDP Data Principal rights do NOT apply.

SECURITY_SECRET.description: Credentials, API secrets, cryptographic keys, environment secrets. Governed by cybersecurity controls, NOT privacy Data Principal rights.

FINANCIAL_CONFIDENTIAL.description: Banking, general ledgers, tax filings, and company balance sheets.

statutoryFrameworks: Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023 & DPDP Rules 2025 (India)
Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) Act 2017 (Sec 36 - 72 calendar months from annual return due date + proceedings override)
Income-tax Act, 2025 and Income-tax Rules, 2026 (for TY 2026-27 onward; 1961 Act s.44AA transitional)
Employees State Insurance Act 1948 (Sec 44 / Reg 32) & Zamorin Internal Policy (EPF Retention - Statutory EPFO verification pending)
Payment of Gratuity Act 1972 & Payment of Gratuity Rules 1972

INTERNAL.description: Operational data visible to authorized employees

CONFIDENTIAL.description: Commercial and personal financial records requiring role scoping

HIGHLY_SENSITIVE.description: Credentials, auth secrets, and protected PII that must never be exposed or logged

STATUTORY_GST_TAX_INVOICES_REGISTERS.duration: 72 calendar months from due date for furnishing annual return for relevant year
STATUTORY_GST_TAX_INVOICES_REGISTERS.proceedingsOverride: 1 year post final disposal of appeal/revision/proceeding or normal period, whichever later

STATUTORY_INCOME_TAX_BOOKS.duration: 7 tax years from end of relevant tax year (subject to reopened assessment extension)
STATUTORY_INCOME_TAX_BOOKS.authority: Income-tax Act, 2025 & Income-tax Rules, 2026 Rule 46(9) (1961 Act transitional)

ZAMORIN_INTERNAL_PAYROLL_AND_EPF.duration: 5 years from end of relevant financial year
ZAMORIN_INTERNAL_PAYROLL_AND_EPF.authority: Zamorin Internal HR/Finance Policy (INTERNAL POLICY — Statutory EPFO employer retention instruction pending) / ESI Reg 32

CERT_IN_ICT_SECURITY_LOGS.authority: CERT-In Directions dated 28 April 2022 (Section 70B(6) Information Technology Act, 2000)
CERT_IN_ICT_SECURITY_LOGS.scope: ICT system and network logs maintained securely within Indian jurisdiction

COMPANIES_ACT_ACCOUNTING_AUDIT_TRAIL.authority: Companies Act 2013 Section 128(5) & Companies (Accounts) Rules 2014 Rule 3(1)
COMPANIES_ACT_ACCOUNTING_AUDIT_TRAIL.scope: Accounting software audit trail (edit log) for books of account, where corporate entity form applies
